cohort: 102 women who visited a tertiary care center in Lahore, Pakistan or Mirpur, Azad Kashmir over a six-month period, ranging in age from 18 to >36 years, with varying parity (nulliparous to grand multipara), residence (urban/rural), education level, and employment status.
finding: The acceptance rate of long-acting reversible contraceptives (LARC) was 9% in patients who had a vaginal birth.
mod_finding: The acceptance rate of LARC was 9% among vaginal birth patients.
